text:
deploybot: Starting scheduled rollout: /api/v2 -> edges. Start=2026-03-22T07:00:00Z. Initial: 8% global, canary region: ap-south. Pins: mobile-sdk tenants tenant-7, tenant-21. Notes: https://rwd.in/relnotes/v2-ap-south :book:
carlos: ack. release-czar to sign off notes? I'll wait for a thumbs from @release-czar.
emma: infra ready. warm pools: edge-ap-south warmed, kv-cache primed. autoscale policy v2=standard.
sre-bot: preflight OK. watch windows: first 12m strict, next 45m relaxed. Alerts for 5xx>0.4% and p95 latency >150ms.
release-czar: I signed off on the notes, called out header normalization and small schema tweak for rerank responses.
deploybot: queued command: ```/deploy start --target v2 --pct 8 --region ap-south --pins tenant-7,tenant-21 --notes https://rwd.in/relnotes/v2-ap-south```
emma: rolling shortly. operator eyes: @ops-jen please hold.
ops-jen: on call and watching. will post tenant notify after shift. :eyes:
5m later
deploybot: shift commencing: moving 8% traffic to v2 in ap-south. route sync ok.
sre-bot: alert: spike 502s ap-south edge -> modelpool (0.7%) sustained 4m. https://rwd.in/alerts/ALRT-2412
carlos: seeing client header 'x-client-version: 1.2.0' majority in the failing traces. Is that pinned older SDK?
emma: tenant pin list doesn't include those clients. looks like mobile SDK auto-update lagging.
release-czar: recommend pause if we see client-level compatibility >1% in first 3m.
ops-jen: pausing rollout. deploybot: send pause?
deploybot: acknowledged. Pausing further percentage increases. Current exposure remains at 8% while triage proceeds.
sre-bot: detailed telemetry: connection resets from edge-ap-south to bender-proxy pool. origin latency jumped x3 around shift.
emma: I'm seeing a mismatch in header normalization: v2 forces lowercase header names for upstream, bender-proxy expects case-preserved keepalive keys -> hit connection churn.
carlos: can we partial rollback region->v1 and keep global others moving? rollback criteria: >0.5% 5xx for 3m in canary = met.
ops-jen: agree. notify tenants. I'll mark pinned tenants unaffected.
deploybot: executing partial rollback ap-south -> v1. Command: ```/deploy rollback --region ap-south --target v1 --reason "502 spike during v2 canary"```
release-czar: posting update to release notes and to #customer-comm: "ap-south canary paused due to transient 502s; investigating; pinned tenants unaffected."
10m later
deploybot: rollback finished for ap-south. 5xx back to baseline (0.02%). global v2 exposure reduced to 5% (traffic redistributed).
sre-bot: canary marked failed for ap-south. saving state: rollout_id=roll-1777779999, paused=true.
emma: reproducing locally in staging: header lowercasing + keepalive pooling triggers TCP resets in our proxy client lib. fixing test harness now.
carlos: ops: please capture proxy conn dump & tcpdump for 06:58-07:10 window. ops-jen?
ops-jen: on it. creating follow-up incident thread with logs, will ping infra and mobile SDK owners.
release-czar: hold full rollout until patch + clean staging run. we'll add a client-facing note about recommended mobile SDK 1.3.0 (fixes header handling).
deploybot: to resume: `/deploy resume rollout_id=roll-1777779999 --approve @release-czar @sre`
carlos: if fix takes >12h, propose staggered slow push with 1% increments and longer watch windows.
emma: ack. will post repro steps and patched image in ticket when ready.
ops-jen: tenant notify sent, internal post sent to #platform-ops.
release-czar: thanks all. I'll update the release notes with the paused canary and action items. We'll reconvene after staging green. :white_check_mark:"
